macros.name: nl
macros.doc: The \nl command inserts a new row with a standard horizontal line above it (used for regular cell boundaries).

macros.name: NL
macros.doc: the \NL command inserts a new row preceded by a thicker horizontal line – typically used to separate Sudoku subgrids.

envs.name: sudoku
envs.doc: The multi-sudoku package defines the sudoku environment, which draws a Sudoku grid of the specified size.
